properties.notes: Largely vacant area of land with one remaining building and the remainder hardstanding following clearance. Reserved matters now approved for development of 6 homes (18/01976/REM). Yet to be started but forecast to be completed in the next 5 years. Within settlement limit and considered to represent an appropriate location for small-scale residential scheme. The latest application follows original outline planning permission (14/04120/OUT). Previous application refused for a single dwelling on part of the SHLAA site.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
